metadata.title: Transposed Poisson structures in graded and algebroid geometry
metadata.abstract: We ask whether the transposed Leibniz rule $2z\cdot[x,y]=[z\cdot x,y]+[x,z\cdot y]$ survives the two passages that turn Poisson algebras into geometry, the shift of degree which produces Gerstenhaber algebras and the passage from algebras to algebroids. We introduce graded transposed Poisson algebras with a bracket of arbitrary degree and show that the parity of the degree decides which shape the answer takes. In even degree, over a unital base, such brackets are in bijection with homogeneous derivations, and on the exterior algebra of a vector bundle in degree zero they are exactly the gauge derivations of the bundle. In odd degree the bracket is forced to be the product with a single element of that degree, so a non-negatively graded algebra carries no non-zero transposed Gerstenhaber bracket. In particular, for a Lie--Rinehart algebra $(A,L)$, the Schouten--Rinehart Gerstenhaber algebra $\Lambda_A L$ is transposed if and only if the anchor and the bracket of $L$ both vanish. We then introduce transposed $F$-algebroids and classify those with an identity: if the rank is at least two the anchor vanishes and the structure is the datum of a derivation of the multiplication, while if the rank is one the bundle is trivialised by the identity and the structure is, globally, the Jacobi bracket of a single vector field. For the tangent $F$-algebroid of an $F$-manifold $M$ this forces $\dim M=1$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 分次代数与 algebroid 分类
analysis.workSummary: 研究转置 Leibniz 法则在分次移位和 algebroid 化后能否保持，证明奇偶次数产生不同结构；分类有单位元的转置 F-algebroid，并对通常 Gerstenhaber 与切 F-algebroid 给出强限制。
analysis.breakthrough: 指出从代数到几何时奇偶性和 anchor 导致的退化障碍。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。结论依赖单位元、分次及秩条件；不能与普通 Poisson 或 Gerstenhaber 结构的分类混淆。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
